acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt for Students is a free resource hub designed to help PT, OT, SLP, and chiropractic students feel more prepared for clinical practice. It gives students exposure to real-world documentation, EMR workflows, responsible AI tools, clinical learning environments, and career resources so they can enter affiliations and early-career roles with more confidence.

mainEntity.name: Why did Prompt create this for students?

acceptedAnswer.text: We created Prompt for Students because the transition from classroom to clinic can be challenging. Prompt helps make that transition easier by giving students earlier exposure to the tools and expectations they will encounter in practice, so they can focus more on learning and caring for patients.

Sidekick for Students gives students hands-on access to AI-powered tools to practice documenting simulated patient cases. With AI Scribing Practice Mode, students can dictate practice visits and generate SOAP notes, while AskAI provides support with clinical, documentation, and compliance questions.

mainEntity.name: What is Jobs on Exxat One?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobs on Exxat One is a job platform built into Exxat where clinics using Prompt can post openings for students and new graduates to search and apply to.

Career Connection is a matching program for clinicians who are ready to explore their next opportunity. Once you have clinical experience and are looking for a practice that better fits how you want to work and grow, Prompt can help connect you with vetted, tech-forward clinics.

mainEntity.name: How does learning on an EMR help me as a student?

acceptedAnswer.text: Learning on an EMR can help you feel more comfortable with documentation, EMR workflows, AI-supported tools, and the pace of clinical practice. It can also make the transition into rotations or early-career roles feel less intimidating because you already understand some of the systems and expectations used in modern clinics.

mainEntity.name: How does being familiar with Prompt help me get hired?

acceptedAnswer.text: EMR proficiency shows employers that you’ve taken the initiative to practice real-world documentation and can help you get up to speed faster during onboarding.

mainEntity.name: What if my university program doesn't use Prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can still access student resources, try Sidekick for Students, and explore available career opportunities. If you want to bring Prompt to your program, you can share our universities page with your program director.
